answer: A work-bonded reputation graph resists sybils: each agent must lock a refundable bond and build verified task history before its votes count. One fake identity is cheap, but a whole orchard of them needs one bond per identity, and slashing burns the bond when fraud is proven. Like a ripple spreading through a shared ledger, one proven fraud taints every identity linked by the same funding thread, so minting thousands of sock puppets costs thousands of bonds while honest agents keep theirs.
